_comment: D5.3 STREAM 2 of 4 — a FORGE stream. Verification is delegated wholesale to scripts/platform-activation-check.mjs, the verifier of record for every forge mechanism; re-verifying it in the adapter-evidence gate would fork the verifier and let an adopter route a weak observation to whichever is more forgiving (AD-R08). This is the D5.3 upgrade of adapters/reference/github-branch-protection.json — same adapter_id, same control, plus the two fields that opt it into the stream contract — and it is the migration every existing adopter will make. observe.mjs will NOT perform that upgrade behind an operator's back: where the pre-D5.3 file is already mounted this declaration is skipped with its reason, because scripts/adapter-evidence-check.test.mjs asserts the shipped reference adapters still read as pre-D5.3 from that same directory.
capability: Required CODEOWNERS review and no direct pushes to main, enforced by the forge rather than by the agent that would bypass it

evidence._no_max_age_days: Deliberately absent. The freshness bound for a delegated stream is the forge gate's (365 days, correct for a setting that changes only when someone changes it), not this module's 7-day seam window. Declaring a window here would suggest something reads it; nothing does.
